title: Ventura County tornado motion and contacts
summary: Restore the recovered tornado material scrolling and decode the twister compound collision sections in the shared Rust engine.
details: The actor shader now applies the three distinct UV-scroll rates declared by the FREE06 twister materials.

A bounded decoder reads ten type-0 sections of each twister3 compound placement, creating thirty collision bodies across the three placements. Moving-body contacts follow current and prior MOT node transforms.

Exact-build evidence: function 0032d330 builds the node table with engine root at index 0, then reads each section node ID and type-0 mesh. Function 0032c490 preserves each section previous transform and computes its current transform from the animated attached node.

Host-only native debug fixture: a stationary quad at tornado-relative offset [-100, 6, 0] received 17 contact steps, peak upward velocity 76.600716 ft/s (about 52 mph), and peak angular velocity 26.073776 rad/s. Offset [-100, 6, -40] received seven contact steps, 29.401508 ft/s upward velocity and 6.081401 rad/s angular velocity; offset [-100, 6, 40] missed with zero contacts. Assertions were verified against these recorded outputs; a duplicate queued rerun was canceled before execution.

Focused browser test passed on checked PR artifact be6957e: the windmill regression recorded 28 contacts and closest distance 6.814 ft; the tornado recorded one sampled contact, peak upward ATV velocity 75.1276855 ft/s and angular velocity 30.6833 rad/s, exceeding the 8 ft/s and 1 rad/s acceptance thresholds. The corrected fixture parks in the westbound funnel path without throttle. Runtime PR #681 merged as b291f49d.

Inspected fixed-camera screenshots from checked artifact 8409c9f7 show a fully framed funnel at actor times 0.267 s and 2.083 s, with visible position and texture-pattern changes. Node motion also changes, so the images do not isolate UV scrolling. The attached first frame is awaiting R2 gallery publication.
Public deployment b291f49d18ce07c114111cffb9fc0cde25d2b5ce was verified live with fetch_site_release --deployed. The gallery upload received HTTP 429 (Cloudflare 10429); its retry is pending.
limitation: Native and browser evidence is host-only. Exact original PS2 player-response and impulse parity, original-hardware visual parity, and physical-phone behavior/performance remain unverified. Public deployment is verified. Screenshot gallery publication is pending after HTTP 429 (Cloudflare 10429) rate limiting.
